claims.explanation: Table 1 is the required 7-of-8 best-method evidence, but aratest evidence rejects its repeated BART0Large/FLAN-T5Large/FLAN-T53B column headers at line 5. Moreover the fixed table visibly contains only seven configurations (2+3+2), not the claimed eight; the omitted setting cannot be invented or the quantifier silently changed to 6-of-7.

The all-eight prior-versus-no-prior comparison relies on Table 1 Representation and w/o Prior rows. Production parsing rejects duplicate model headers at line 5, and the seven visible columns do not identify an eighth configuration. No numeric values are copied into replacement evidence and no all-seven substitute is declared.

Table 1 contains the required BART0Large Full FT trainable-logit/threshold pair 57.15/55.75 and FLAN-T5Large LoRA 36.54/43.93 and Full FT 40.91/48.43. The production parser rejects its duplicate model headers. Figure 2(a) demonstrates token-level transfer on one example pair but does not replace these configuration-level F1 operands.

One comparative property includes all four Table 3 sequential error-fixing model/tuning settings, comparing Representation replay with Random replay on EM Drop (%). Table 4 is separate single-error fixing and is intentionally not substituted; success rate is not an asserted conjunct of C04.

Table 2 P3-TestOOD binary F1 on BART0Large Full FT: Representation with prior must exceed Threshold; Threshold must exceed both Trainable Logit and w/o Prior. The second property aggregates both unsuccessful alternatives. This preserves the word only, not merely best-of-all performance; ID scores are outside the claim.

C06 and Table 8 state the 1/6700 FLOP magnitude for FLAN-T5Large Full FT with 3,600 upstream examples; this source assertion is preserved without correcting it from the displayed FLOP counts. The full claim also requires EM Drop comparable to ground-truth replay, with a factor-two falsifier, but does not specify whether the replay population is the single FLOP-example configuration or all four Table 3 settings inherited through C04. E05 describes FLOP profiling, not that replay comparison population. Narrowing the replay scope would therefore invent a condition. Moreover, opposite ratio inequalities do not establish faithful rounded-ratio equality semantics for the stated 1/6700 magnitude without an invented tolerance. The complete C06 declaration is withdrawn rather than publishing a narrowed comparison or silently weakening its magnitude.
